string.text:
An anomaly has altered these combat boots: the worn leather glows softly with golden light, and occasional electric sparks run along its creases.
 
While on the belt, the boots reduce wear on weapons, outfits and helmets during radio-beacon travel by 70%. Journeys on foot to radio beacons take half as much real time. In-game travel time is unchanged.
 
No effects while in the backpack.
